node.label: Reduced Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 activity in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: Concentration or activity of inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme has phosphoinositide 5-phosphatase (EC 3.1.3.36) activity.

evidence.snippet: Lowe syndrome: Reduced Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 activity in cultured fibroblasts [PCS]
